items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: And we had a little gal 12 years old by the name of Terry Carrington played drums

ctx.x: And we had a little gal 12 years old by the name of Terry Carrington played drums, and she gave Lionel Hampton a fit. I mean she can play. I have never heard anything like that so young in my life, the way that girl -- she played like a man and solo and even -- everything's even. When she'd get through, she said, doodle-dee-doo-doo, dooley-doo-doo-bop. You could (inaudible) say you got it now.
